svg.text: Inlet slots: 50 x 50 centred 45 left and 12 forward of centre;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 50 x 40 centred 45 right and 17 forward of centre.

svg.text: PM sensor cradle, 45 left and 23 back of centre: two ribs 50 long,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 thick, 25 tall, 12.5 apart inside; two pads 6 wide, 8 tall, 34

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: apart, between the ribs. The sensor stands on the pads, inlet down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: NO2 sensor: 28 mm window 45 right and 24 back of centre, inside a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: collar 38 outside, 32.6 inside, 15 tall. The sensor sits face down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Corner holes 3.4 mm, 78 each side and 48 forward and back of centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mesh: cut stainless insect mesh 160 x 100; punch the four corner holes;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it goes under the floor, held by the four M3 screws.
